The package includes:

	● 2 nights in exclusive rooms

	● Exquisite dinner in the glow of candles with a carafe of excellent wine

	● Excellent dinner on the second day of stay

	● Fresh fruit and sparkling wine served to the room

	● Rich breakfast in the form of a Swedish buffet

	● Unlimited access to the hotel spa zone, equipped with a jacuzzi, sauna, salt cave and gym

	● In the summer season, the possibility of using an external pool and a hotel recreation zone

	● Ceragem massages on the bed

	● Free rental of Nordic walking sticks

	The package is available all week, not only on weekends.

	The stays start at 15:00 and end at 11:00 on the day of departure.
